summary.text: Jeff Cooling is a Democratic state representative from Iowa House District 77 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as electrician.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Cooling's career experience includes working as an electrician.
He won the Democratic primary for Iowa House District 77 on June 7, 2022, and the general election on November 8, 2022, succeeding Amy Nielsen in the seat.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him assigned to the House Agriculture, House Appropriations, Labor, House Transportation and House State Government committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and is listed as the candidate in the general election.
